mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates exceeding 3.5% indicate labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (supply) and payrolls (labor) signal an economic slowdown, reducing corporate profitability and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth combined with low unemployment indicates an overheating economy, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 20500 and UNRATE is below 3.6.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1350 units signal reduced consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 45% of instances where HOUST falls below 1350.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation exceeding 256.5 index points indicates rising price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 256.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales growth increases consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of instances where RSAFS rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL below 255) indicate accommodative monetary policy without inflationary risks, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS is below 2.0 and CPIAUCSL is below 255.
